title: Calendar planner
idea: Calendar planner: Time-based work blocks share a clear date context with unscheduled items and conflict detail.
audience: People who need to plan calendar within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Duration and adjacency matter to the task.
avoidWhen: Calendar density would make most events unreadable.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its plan calendar priority and explicit commitment contract: Resolve conflicts against the current authoritative schedule before saving.
navigation: Calendar planner keeps the current plan calendar context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Time-based work blocks share a clear date context with unscheduled items and conflict detail.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to plan calendar; duration and adjacency matter to the task.
composition.priority: Resolve conflicts against the current authoritative schedule before saving.

imagery.role: Support the actual plan calendar context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use an agenda-first small-screen view with explicit date navigation.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the calendar planner structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no plan calendar content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Resolve conflicts against the current authoritative schedule before saving.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized plan calendar content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Resolve conflicts against the current authoritative schedule before saving.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active plan calendar context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
